create_fake_dataset: create a fake ASE database with random atomic structures from a FakeDatasetConfig
generate_structures: generate fake atomic structures with Lennard-Jones energies and repulsive forces from a config
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: create all five UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes in a temp directory
config_get_split_config: get the split configuration dictionary with source and metadata path from a FakeDatasetConfig
config_get_normalization_constants: get energy and forces normalization constants with mean and stdev from a FakeDatasetConfig
